questions.prompt: The Salem witch trials took place in which century?
questions.fact: The colony later issued formal apologies and compensation to survivors and families, within twenty years.

questions.prompt: Which gas is most responsible for the smell of rotten eggs?
questions.fact: It deadens the sense of smell at high concentrations, which makes it far more dangerous than the warning suggests.

questions.prompt: Which sport uses a term called a nutmeg?
questions.fact: It means playing the ball through an opponent's legs, and the origin of the name is genuinely disputed.

questions.prompt: Which artist painted the Mona Lisa?
questions.fact: It became globally famous partly because it was stolen in 1911 and missing for two years.

questions.prompt: Which strait separates Sicily from mainland Italy?
questions.fact: A bridge across it has been proposed repeatedly since Roman times and never built.

questions.prompt: Which novel is narrated by a character called Pi Patel?
questions.fact: The book offers two versions of events and explicitly asks the reader to choose which to believe.

questions.prompt: Which protocol transfers files between a client and server?
questions.fact: It sends credentials in plain text, which is why secure variants replaced it for anything sensitive.
